# Anthropic

Use `anthropic/<model>` with VoltAgent's model router.

## Quick start

```ts
import { Agent } from "@voltagent/core";

const agent = new Agent({
  name: "anthropic-agent",
  instructions: "You are a helpful assistant",
  model: "anthropic/claude-fable-5",
});
```

- `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`

`@ai-sdk/anthropic`

Not listed.
